title: Home Delivery Pharmacy and Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit: Retail Bridge Courtesy on a Delayed Order
content:
## Cross-benefit coordination note: retail fills during a dispensing delay

**Rule.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy dispensing-delay credit, a retail bridge courtesy amount is added for a supply of the delayed drug bought at a retail pharmacy, counted as paid retail claims for that drug dated less than three whole months before the handling date: 12.00 for two or more such claims, 6.00 for exactly one, and nothing for none.

The claims read are the member's paid claims under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit: status paid, drug name and date of service. The delayed drug is the drug on the home delivery shipment record of the delayed order. The courtesy amount is added to the credit.

### Courtesy by paid retail claims

| Paid retail claims for the delayed drug, dated less than three whole months before the handling date | Courtesy |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 12.00 |
| exactly 1 | 6.00 |
| none | nothing |

### Hypothetical cases

- Two paid network claims for the delayed drug, five and nine weeks before the handling date: 12.00.
- One paid claim for the delayed drug and one reversed claim for it: only the paid claim counts, 6.00.
- A paid claim for the delayed drug dated four months earlier: outside the span, nothing.
